description.zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用[ListClusters](~~87116~~)获取集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

description.zh:
计算节点规格。

您可以调用[ListPreferredEcsTypes](~~188592~~)接口获取E-HPC推荐的节点规格信息。
description.en:
The instance type of the node.

You can call the [ListPreferredEcsTypes](~~188592~~) operation to query the recommended instance types.

description.zh:
部署集ID。
您可以通过[DescribeDeploymentSets](~~91313~~)获取部署集ID，当前仅支持网络低时延策略的部署集。
description.en: The ID of the deployment set. You can obtain the deployment set ID by calling the [DescribeDeploymentSets](~~91313~~) operation. Only the deployment sets that use low latency policy are supported.

description.zh:
弹性网卡的通讯模式。取值范围：

- Standard：使用TCP通讯模式。
- HighPerformance：开启ERI（Elastic RDMA Interface）接口，使用RDMA通讯模式。
description.en:
The communication mode of the elastic network interface (ENI). Valid values:

*   Standard: uses the TCP communication mode.
*   HighPerformance: uses the remote direct memory access (RDMA) communication mode with Elastic RDMA Interface (ERI) enabled.

description.zh:
资源组ID。

您可以通过调用[ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~)获取资源组ID。
description.en:
The resource group ID.

You can call the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) operation to query the IDs of resource groups.

title.zh: 更新队列资源组和计算节点实例信息

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明
更新资源组后，如果您通过集群扩容新增节点，节点将会自动添加到新的资源组。
descriptions.en: After you update the resource group, the nodes that you add by scaling out the cluster are automatically included in the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc update-queue-config --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --queue-name workq --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4ph0000 --compute-instance-type ecs.n1.tiny --deployment-set-id ds-bp1frxuzdg87zh4pzq0000 --network-interface-traffic-mode Standard --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpc UpdateQueueConfig --region cn-hangzhou --DeploymentSetId 'ds-bp1frxuzdg87zh4pzq0000' --NetworkInterfaceTrafficMode Standard --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxazb4ph0000' --ClusterId 'ehpc-hz-FYUr320000' --QueueName workq --ComputeInstanceType 'ecs.n1.tiny'
